assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - chemical exposure at PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 14 January 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
